notes.title: Hop Into the Froggy Sale And Follow For New Updates! 🐸
notes.content:
Hey Toadled fans!
We’re thrilled to announce that Toadled Classic is part of the epic Froggy Sale, where you can snag the game at a discount alongside a bunch of other ridiculous, frog-themed adventures. Whether you’re hopping through classic toad chaos or checking out some new amphibious friends, this sale is the perfect excuse to dive back into the pond!

Why Stop There?
We’ve got something even more exciting on the horizon for Toadled fans. While we can't say much yet, let's just say there’s a lot more eating, growing, and mayhem on the way. Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates and a brand new take on your favorite hungry toad! 🐸✨ (Hint: early concept art included below 😉)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/ff73c6e855aa9351ef529fd3dbf9f548e4c8573f.png

Don’t Miss a Ribbit
Follow our Steam Dev page or join our Discord to get the latest news, playtest invites, updates, and more sneak peeks at what’s coming soon. Trust us, you won’t want to miss this!
